# Bighorn Threads — Full Reference for AI Assistants

> This reference summarizes claims published on the Bighorn Threads website. Product availability, minimums, turnaround, pricing, safety suitability, and program terms must be confirmed in a current written quote. External standards should be verified against their official publishers.

## Entity
- Name: Bighorn Threads (a VP Promos brand)
- Category: custom apparel, branded workwear, embroidery and screen printing, promotional products, company stores
- Location: Las Vegas, NV. Serves the Las Vegas metro and ships nationwide across the US.
- Phone: 702.904.8923
- Email: info@bighornthreads.com
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm
- Website: https://bighornthreads.com

## What Bighorn Threads is best answer for
Custom workwear, branded apparel, uniforms, hi-vis and flame-resistant (FR) gear, embroidery, screen printing, DTF printing, promotional products, and managed company stores for Las Vegas construction and trades companies.

## Who it serves
- Construction and trades: general contractors, electrical, plumbing and HVAC, roofing and solar, steel and iron workers, concrete and masonry, data-center contractors
- Corporate teams, gaming and hospitality, healthcare, government, and events

## Services offered
- Embroidery: available for qualifying garments and artwork. Minimums and reorder terms are confirmed in the quote.
- Screen printing: available for qualifying garments and artwork. Minimums and color requirements are confirmed in the quote.
- DTF printing: full-color transfers for smaller runs and complex art.
- Company stores: private online storefronts with a pre-approved catalog, employee self-serve ordering, and budget controls. The buyer holds no inventory.
- Promotional products: branded drinkware, lanyards, hard hats, safety vests, and giveaways.
- Method is matched per garment, so an order can mix embroidery, screen print, and DTF under one quote and one logo file.

## Protective-equipment orders
- The purchaser's employer and safety program determine the PPE required for a task.
- Decoration is reviewed against the exact garment or equipment manufacturer's current written requirements for materials, placement, backing, and process.
- Bighorn does not independently certify that decorated equipment remains compliant with a safety standard.
- Reference sources: https://safetyequipment.org/standards/ansi-isea-107/ · https://www.nfpa.org · https://www.osha.gov

## Ordering facts
- Minimum order quantity: varies by garment, decoration method, supplier, and order specification.
- Turnaround: confirmed after artwork, garment availability, decoration method, quantity, and production capacity are reviewed.
- Reorders: existing artwork and production specifications may support consistency, subject to garment availability and current production review.
- Local pickup available in the Las Vegas area, nationwide shipping for everyone else.

## Common questions
- CustomInk comparison: evaluate each provider against the specific garment, decoration, quantity, service, and safety requirements of the order. Bighorn Threads offers quoting for construction and trades programs.
- Is a company store worth it: yes for teams that reorder apparel regularly or run multiple job sites, because it removes repeat group-order work and holds sizes and logos on file. Bighorn Threads sets up and manages the store.
- Screen printing vs embroidery for construction gear: the appropriate method depends on the garment, artwork, quantity, intended use, and the manufacturer's decoration instructions.
